title: Mid-market Restaurant Equity Stake For Sale in Balakong, Malaysia
tagline: Fast-growing restaurant group, proudly 100% Bumiputera and Muslim-owned, launched just 2 years ago. - In our first full year, we sold over 3 million Nasi Padang meals, showcasing the strong demand for our food. - We set a Malaysia Book of Records title by serving over 23,000 plates in a single day. - Our expansion has been rapid, with nearly 60 outlets opened in just 20 months—10 are company-owned and operated, while the rest are franchisees. - We’ve built a strong customer base with over 300,000 registered members and more than 100,000 app downloads within the first month. - Our outlets have received high praise, consistently maintaining an average rating of 4.5★ on Google reviews, and we are also the winner of the AFTA Malaysia Best Restaurant award. - Last year, the revenue exceeded MYR 50 million, including revenue from company-owned outlets and 5% monthly royalties from franchisees. - We anticipate exceeding MYR 100 million in revenue and are targeting more than 80 outlets by the end of next year. - All outlets operate as full-service restaurants, with an average seating capacity of 30, and we regularly hire temporary employees to support operations. - We are proud to be Halal certified and fully registered with SSM, ensuring our commitment to quality and trust.
